sensor_sites.label: Betrawati reach
sensor_sites.why: Furthest downstream station of the Bhote Koshi replay, next to the Hub; sees the surge last.

sensor_sites.label: Syabrubesi reach
sensor_sites.why: At Syabrubesi, the first town the replay's surge reaches.

sensor_sites.label: Timure reach
sensor_sites.why: Below the confluence, on the way to Syabrubesi.

sensor_sites.label: Lhende-Kyirong confluence
sensor_sites.why: Furthest upstream station of the replay; sees the surge first.

hub_site.label: Betrawati
hub_site.why: Where the Bhote Koshi replay's Hub has always run: the town at the bottom of the reach, about 7 km from the Betrawati reach sensor site, which sees the surge last.
